title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS, SCIENTIFIC KNOWLEDGE AND FACTUALITY: A FRAMEWORK TO STREAMLINE HUMAN EXPERT EVALUATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation of factual biomedical knowledge (chemical-fungus relations) and correlating the frequency of the model's outputted entities (e.g., the fungus Aspergillus) with their citation frequency in the PubMed training corpus to demonstrate a preference for over-represented entities.
